exposure: Use of prophylactic postoperative antibiotics (PP-Abx) after emergent cesarean delivery with povidone-iodine skin preparation
outcome: Postpartum infection or wound complication (endometritis, wound infection, cellulitis, seroma, hematoma, or intra-abdominal abscess)
cohort: Patients undergoing emergent cesarean delivery with povidone-iodine skin preparation at a single institution from July 2012 to April 2020
finding: In this cohort study of patients undergoing emergent cesarean delivery, the routine use of prophylactic postoperative antibiotics after povidone-iodine skin preparation did not reduce the rate of postpartum infection or wound complication.
